examples.text: Ze kandideerde zich voor de positie van burgermeester.
examples.translation: She nominated herself as candidate for the position of mayor.
examples.english: She nominated herself as candidate for the position of mayor.

examples.text: De partij wil hem niet kandideren.
examples.translation: The party does not want to nominate him as candidate.
examples.english: The party does not want to nominate him as candidate.

examples.translation: I do not want to nominate [myself] as candidate.
examples.english: I do not want to nominate [myself] as candidate.

glosses: Poser sa candidature, se porter candidat.
